page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, translating to 8.0 GB of memory per core. The CPU cache configuration includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core benchmarks. Memory bandwidth is stable, with read-only cached speeds reaching 654.2 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 75.3 GB/sec. Cryptographic and vector operations are supported via AVX, AVX512F, and AES instruction sets, though newer extensions like AVX-512 VNNI or AMX are absent.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, the ecs.se1ne.4xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without demanding top-tier single-threaded compute performance. The primary tradeoff is the lower single-core processing speed, making it less suitable for latency-sensitive, single-threaded applications. However, its average multi-core scaling, solid memory bandwidth, and database performance, such as Redis SET operations at 11.19 million operations per second, make it well-suited for memory-intensive workloads. These include relational databases, in-memory caching layers, medium-scale data processing, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from a larger memory footprint.
